instruction: Candid street photograph, full shot. Outdoors in front of a wooden doorway, the blonde woman in a brown cap and black vest (R1) on the left and the red-haired woman in a blue knit vest and brown pleated skirt (R2) on the right stand facing each other. They raise their hands to share a high-five in the center, smiling under natural daylight.
elements: R1 actively raises her hand toward R2 for the shared high-five
R2 actively raises her hand toward R1 for the shared high-five
R1 and R2 face each other while raising their hands to meet
Their raised hands meet in the center for the high-five
The interaction happens outdoors in front of a wooden doorway

questions.q: Is R1 raising a hand to complete a high-five with R2, rather than R1 remaining fully passive with both hands down?
Are R1 and R2 the two people whose hands meet in the high-five, rather than interacting with someone else?
Is R2 also raising a hand toward R1 for the high-five, rather than keeping both hands down?
